function.description: Retrieves EoX summary for all devices in the network
function.name: api_getEoXSummary

hardwareCount.description: Number of hardware EoX alerts detected on the network

moduleCount.description: Number of module EoX alerts detected on the network

softwareCount.description: Number of software EoX alerts detected on the network

totalCount.description: Total number of EoX alerts detected on the network. This is the sum of hardwareCount, softwareCount and moduleCount.
